title: Sunshine Hearts
description: A bright, playful painting made by Maya to remind little patients that every day can feel like a sunny day.
warmWords: Hello! I painted this for you because I know sometimes days can feel cloudy, but remember that sunshine is always there waiting to peek through. You're brave and strong, and I hope this painting brings you some of that sunshine feeling!

title: Dream Garden
description: A watercolor piece inspired by peaceful gardens and happy memories.
warmWords: I created this garden just for you! Gardens are magical places where flowers grow and dreams come true. I hope this painting helps you feel peaceful and happy, like you're in your own special garden full of love.

title: Star Wishes
description: A dreamy night sky filled with stars and wishes for healing.
warmWords: Look up at the stars and make a wish! I painted this sky full of stars because I believe in wishes coming true. You're a star too - bright, beautiful, and full of magic. Keep shining!

title: Love Waves
description: Flowing waves of color representing love and healing energy.
warmWords: These waves are made of love and healing energy! Just like the ocean waves that keep moving and changing, you have so much strength inside you. Let these colors remind you that love surrounds you always.

title: Rainbow Hugs
description: A colorful rainbow made with crayons, full of hugs and hope.
warmWords: Rainbows appear after rain, and they remind us that good things come after tough times. This rainbow is giving you a big hug! You're colorful, you're special, and you're loved. Keep being your amazing self!

title: Hope Lights
description: Soft lights and gentle colors bringing calm and hope.
warmWords: These lights are like little beacons of hope shining just for you! Even on the darkest days, there's always a light somewhere. You're that light for so many people. Keep glowing and know that you're never alone.
